title: Rigidity and moduli — Question 3.1
exact_target: Seek a polyhedral parameterization of all taut foliations, with flows assigned to faces, compatible limits on their boundaries, and a polyhedral map to the Thurston norm ball.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 10300005 (AMR-102-0005). CC BY 4.0.
